# registry_site (Data Source)

The site this provider is talking to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "registry_site" "this" {}

# Useful for keying configuration on which site this is, instead of
# hardcoding it in every workspace.
output "site" {
  value = data.registry_site.this.site
}

output "config_version" {
  value = data.registry_site.this.config_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `config_source` (String) Where that document lives — a file, or an object in the blob store.
- `config_version` (String) sha256 of the configuration document currently in force.
- `database` (String) `up`, `unavailable` or `disabled`. Reads survive `unavailable`; publishing does not.
- `feeds` (Number) How many feeds are configured.
- `replication_enabled` (Boolean) Whether this site federates.
- `replication_peers` (Number) How many peers it is configured with.
- `replication_topology` (String) Federation topology.
- `site` (String) Site name.
